newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Subic zone can give telecom licence - justice dept.
newsitem.headline: Subic zone can give telecom licence - justice dept.

text.p: The Subic and Clark special freeport zones in the Philippines have authority to grant telecommunications franchises, the Philippines' justice department said in a legal opinion released on Saturday.
The telecommunications department has said the two freeport authorities could not issue telecommunications licences to interested operators. It said only the Congress could grant franchises.

"The SBMA (Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority) is authorised under its charter to grant a franchise to a telecommunications entity which will put up and operate telecommunciations facilities within the Subic Special Economic Zone only and solely for the use and benefit of the resident of the zone," justice secretary Teofisto Guingona said in his opinion.
He said the same ruling applied to Clark Development Corp (CDC).
Both SBMA and CDC are operators of the country's two premier freeport zones. Many companies have been relocating inside the zones to take advantage of the duty and tax incentives.
